description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core middleware component for global error handling. It intercepts exceptions thrown during HTTP request processing, logs errors, and serializes appropriate JSON error responses based on the exception type.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling exceptions during HTTP request processing in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes the next middleware and catches exceptions to handle them centrally.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by setting response status codes and serializing error messages based on exception type.
